cd /workspace/tmp && timeout 300 python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys, json, random, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import main as impl
rng = random.Random(2024)
best = (0, None)
results = []
for trial in range(40):
    nserv = rng.choice([24, 20, 16])
    svc = ['t%d'%i for i in range(nserv)]
    atoms = []
    for _ in range(10):
        L = rng.choice([3,4,4,4,5])
        p = tuple(rng.choice(svc) for _ in range(L))
        atoms.append(('contains',[svc.index(t) for t in p]))
    try:
        order = impl.build_product(atoms, nserv)[0]
        n = len(order)
    except impl.ComplexityError:
        continue
    req = {'services':svc,'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'and','args':[{'op':'contains','path':[svc[i] for i in p]} for (_op,p) in atoms]}}],'queries':[[svc[0]]]}
    payload = json.dumps(req).encode()
    t0=time.time(); got = impl.process(payload); t1=time.time()
    results.append((round(t1-t0,2), n, nserv))
    if n > best[0]:
        best = (n, (nserv, [len(p) for (_o,p) in atoms], round(t1-t0,2)))
results.sort(reverse=True)
print('slowest:', results[:8])
print('max product under cap:', best)
EOF
